units.rawText: The massive explosion is accompanied by streaks of flame, causing heavy tremors that deter the Balmung's advance.
units.displayText: The massive explosion is accompanied by streaks of flame, causing heavy tremors that deter the Balmung's advance.

spans.text: The massive explosion is accompanied by streaks of flame, causing heavy tremors that deter the Balmung's advance.

units.rawText: Erwin leads the base troops onto the battlefield, just in time.
units.displayText: Erwin leads the base troops onto the battlefield, just in time.

spans.text: Erwin leads the base troops onto the battlefield, just in time.

units.rawText: Evelyn, fall back!
units.displayText: Evelyn, fall back!

spans.text: Evelyn, fall back!

units.rawText: Team 2, advance with me and stop it! Cover Evelyn's retreat!
units.displayText: Team 2, advance with me and stop it! Cover Evelyn's retreat!

spans.text: Team 2, advance with me and stop it! Cover Evelyn's retreat!

units.rawText: Team 1, take care of those cowards who only know how to launch sneak attacks! The rest of you, provide long-range fire support for Team 2!
units.displayText: Team 1, take care of those cowards who only know how to launch sneak attacks! The rest of you, provide long-range fire support for Team 2!

spans.text: Team 1, take care of those cowards who only know how to launch sneak attacks! The rest of you, provide long-range fire support for Team 2!

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: Under the sudden surge of pressure, Evelyn and Erwin show incredible coordination while leading their respective forces.
units.displayText: Under the sudden surge of pressure, Evelyn and Erwin show incredible coordination while leading their respective forces.

spans.text: Under the sudden surge of pressure, Evelyn and Erwin show incredible coordination while leading their respective forces.

units.rawText: The massive mechanical construct wavers under the barrage of fire from all around it.
units.displayText: The massive mechanical construct wavers under the barrage of fire from all around it.

spans.text: The massive mechanical construct wavers under the barrage of fire from all around it.

units.rawText: Scouts? Are the scouts there? We need to know where this thing's core is!
units.displayText: Scouts? Are the scouts there? We need to know where this thing's core is!

spans.text: Scouts? Are the scouts there? We need to know where this thing's core is!

units.rawText: I'm on it! Give me a bit more time!
units.displayText: I'm on it! Give me a bit more time!

spans.text: I'm on it! Give me a bit more time!

units.rawText: Don't bother scanning it, we'll all be cold corpses by the time you finish going over that tin can!
units.displayText: Don't bother scanning it, we'll all be cold corpses by the time you finish going over that tin can!

spans.text: Don't bother scanning it, we'll all be cold corpses by the time you finish going over that tin can!

units.rawText: ...Got it, marking now!
units.displayText: ...Got it, marking now!

spans.text: ...Got it, marking now!

units.rawText: The two scouts quickly identify the Balmung's weak spots and sync this information to everyone's comm systems.
units.displayText: The two scouts quickly identify the Balmung's weak spots and sync this information to everyone's comm systems.

spans.text: The two scouts quickly identify the Balmung's weak spots and sync this information to everyone's comm systems.

units.rawText: Focus fire! Hit it hard, now!
units.displayText: Focus fire! Hit it hard, now!

spans.text: Focus fire! Hit it hard, now!

units.rawText:
Creak— Creak—
(Mechanical groan)
units.displayText:
Creak— Creak—
(Mechanical groan)

spans.text:
Creak— Creak—
(Mechanical groan)

units.rawText: The massive mech staggers under the increased weight of fire, and sparks fly from its joints.
units.displayText: The massive mech staggers under the increased weight of fire, and sparks fly from its joints.

spans.text: The massive mech staggers under the increased weight of fire, and sparks fly from its joints.

units.rawText: The bigger they are, the harder they fall. Change targets, get rid of these SRA bastards!
units.displayText: The bigger they are, the harder they fall. Change targets, get rid of these SRA bastards!

spans.text: The bigger they are, the harder they fall. Change targets, get rid of these SRA bastards!

units.rawText: Beep— Beep—
units.displayText: Beep— Beep—

spans.text: Beep— Beep—

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

spans.text: What?

units.rawText: It shouldn't be this easy to take out... This isn't an ordinary test unit!
units.displayText: It shouldn't be this easy to take out... This isn't an ordinary test unit!

spans.text: It shouldn't be this easy to take out... This isn't an ordinary test unit!

units.rawText: Thump!
units.displayText: Thump!

spans.text: Thump!

units.rawText: The Balmung, which was on the verge of collapse, suddenly finds its feet and swings its massive metal fists at the people around it.
units.displayText: The Balmung, which was on the verge of collapse, suddenly finds its feet and swings its massive metal fists at the people around it.

spans.text: The Balmung, which was on the verge of collapse, suddenly finds its feet and swings its massive metal fists at the people around it.

units.rawText: Directly trace and mark the dynamic and mechanical connection points! Even if we can't find its core, it'll be just as disabled if we can take out its propulsion!
units.displayText: Directly trace and mark the dynamic and mechanical connection points! Even if we can't find its core, it'll be just as disabled if we can take out its propulsion!

spans.text: Directly trace and mark the dynamic and mechanical connection points! Even if we can't find its core, it'll be just as disabled if we can take out its propulsion!

units.rawText: Erwin, get back! It's got add-on packs like the kind you'd find on a frontline heavy mech!
units.displayText: Erwin, get back! It's got add-on packs like the kind you'd find on a frontline heavy mech!

spans.text: Erwin, get back! It's got add-on packs like the kind you'd find on a frontline heavy mech!
